name: dsh-local-trim
description: One-step local model onboarding plus a light harness for DSH: probes local inference endpoints, registers the provider, then trims tools, prompt sections, and tool schemas for that provider only. Ships a cross-platform status panel (scan gguf in OS-standard locations, adopt with VRAM-aware resource pre-check, smoke-test, launch/stop the backend, watch trim savings) inside the plugin detail page.
author: Leonlee114514
